settings.heading: Fast results you rinse off vs lasting results you walk away from
settings.content: Bleach-based cleaners are built for speed: spray, wait half a minute, rinse. The catch is everything that goes with it — the fumes, the runoff onto your plants, the rinse water through your lawn, and doing it all again next season. Soak n Go takes the opposite bet: soak once with a bleach-free, acid-free formula and let rain and UV finish the job over the following weeks. Slower to start. Cleaner for longer. Nothing to rinse.
